scenes.say: Suddenly seeing two of everything? Don't brush it off.

scenes.en: Six tiny muscles move each eye. Nerves from the brain control them.
scenes.say: Six tiny muscles move each eye, controlled by nerves from the brain. Both eyes must point at the same spot.

scenes.en: The brain gets two different pictures, so you see double.
scenes.ta: இரண்டு கண்களும் ஒரே இடத்தைப் பார்க்காவிட்டால் இரட்டைப் பார்வை
scenes.say: If one eye drifts even a little, the brain gets two different pictures, and you see double.

scenes.en: Cover one eye. Does the double image go away?
scenes.say: Quick check. Cover one eye. If the double image goes away, your eyes are not lining up, and a doctor needs to find out why.

scenes.en: Sudden double vision can be linked to diabetes, high BP, stroke or nerve problems.
scenes.ta: சர்க்கரை, ரத்த அழுத்தம், பக்கவாதம் காரணமாக இருக்கலாம்
scenes.say: Did you know? Sudden double vision can be linked to diabetes, high blood pressure, a stroke, or a nerve problem.

scenes.en: With severe headache, drooping eyelid, weakness, slurred speech or dizziness.
scenes.ta: தலைவலி, கண் இமை தொங்குதல், பேச்சு குழறல் இருந்தால் உடனே மருத்துவமனை
scenes.say: Go to a hospital immediately if it comes with a severe headache, a drooping eyelid, weakness, slurred speech, or dizziness.
Don't drive, and get checked the same day. For regular eye care, book an eye test.
